login.title: Signing in
login.body_suffix: . You'll come straight back once signed in.
login.body_generic: Taking you to your identity provider. You'll come straight back once signed in.

logout.title: You're signed out
logout.message: Your app session and the Keycloak session both ended. Close the browser to be certain on a shared machine.

errors.invalid_state: Invalid authentication state. Please try again.

settings_form.title: Keycloak
settings_form.description: Connection to your Keycloak server and how its roles map to this app.

server_url.label: Server URL
server_url.help: Base address of the Keycloak server. Changing it needs a restart.

realm.label: Realm
realm.help: Name of the Keycloak realm users sign in to.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: ID of the client registered for this app in Keycloak.

client_secret.label: Client secret
client_secret.help: Secret of that client. It is hidden once saved.

trust_tenant_claim.label: Trust tenant claim in tokens
trust_tenant_claim.help: Only turn on if users cannot influence the realm mapper that sets the tenant in their token. Otherwise a user could pick their own tenant.

roles_claim_path.label: Roles claim path
roles_claim_path.help: Where the list of roles sits inside the token, written as a dotted path.

jwks_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Signing key cache lifetime (seconds)
jwks_cache_ttl_seconds.help: How long Keycloak's signing keys are reused before being fetched again. With 0 they are refetched on demand, at most every 30 seconds, and the last good set is kept if a fetch fails.

role_mapping.label: Role mapping
role_mapping.help: Maps Keycloak role names to this app's app-wide roles. Tenant roles come from memberships.
